limitations: Read-only log audit; no actions, rewards, resets, model parameters or training data changed.
Completed restored segments only; still-active segments are excluded.
Initial restored life is not an exact near-collision window; later native lives and boot games may also practice the obstacle.
Score threshold is the observed control maximum, not a course-position label or training criterion.
An unarchived first loss is bounded, not assigned an invented timestamp.
Coverage does not prove why training fails or that more frequent resets would improve it.
